entities.name: Nikola Jurišić

entities.summary: Baron Nikola Jurišić was a Croatian nobleman, soldier, and diplomat. He is known for commanding a force with fewer than 50 soldiers and only 700 villagers during the Siege of Kőszeg against a much larger Ottoman army of 120,000–140,000, stopping its advance.

entities.summary: Baron Nikola Jurišić was a Croatian nobleman, soldier, and diplomat. He is known for commanding a force with fewer than 50 soldiers and only 700 villagers during the Siege of Kőszeg against a much larger Ottoman army of 120,000–140,000, stopping its advance.
